title: FAME artifact: metamodels, constraints, scenario and seeded-violation test set
description:
Companion artifact for Construction Before Alignment: Trustworthy Models and Correspondences for Semantic Interoperability (Ocansey, Lamo, Rutle, Rabbi).

Contains:

  • the FAME core and correspondence metamodels (Ecore), with a generated variant carrying OCL validation delegates;
  • all static well-formedness conditions as a Complete OCL document;
  • the healthcare running scenario of Section 2: three system models and the five correspondences C1-C5;
  • a synthetic source-artefact corpus, so that every provenance reference resolves and condition B1 is checkable end to end;
  • a 22-instance seeded-violation test set, one deliberate violation per seedable invariant;
  • the typed correspondence notation, with a parser, serialiser and round-trip test;
  • a dependency-free reference validator that also serves as the resolver for conditions E5 and E7.

Verification: python3 tests/run_tests.py (Python 3.8+, no dependencies) reports 25 passing checks.

Dual licence. Code under tools/ and tests/ is Apache-2.0. Models, constraints, scenario instances, the artefact corpus, figures and documentation are CC-BY-4.0. Zenodo records a single identifier; see LICENSE in the archive for the split.

Scope. The LLM-based construction pipeline of Section 5 is not included; it belongs to the enabling paper and is archived separately. No SAT/SMT solver (condition D3) and no update operations (conditions T2, G2) are included. See the README section "Known gaps".
